note: Flag an entity when its risk (sigmoid of the adapted probe's score, detector v4) is at least the threshold. Thresholds flag 10% (balanced) and 5% (strict) of true entities in out-of-fold scores on the 1,809 subjects v4 was fitted on; held-out rates measured once on the fresh test set (437 people, 498 subjects; docs/LIBRARY.md).

balanced.fit: flags 10% of supported entities (out of fold)

strict.fit: flags 5% of supported entities (out of fold)
